# Available support for carers

Add to read later Print

Please select from the following articles.

Tailored Support Packages

2 minute read

Tailored support packages are designed to provide you with services and support specific to your needs to help you in your caring role.

Add to read later Read more about Tailored Support Packages

Planned and emergency respite

1 minute read

‘Respite’ or ‘respite care’ is when someone else takes care of the person you care for, so that you can have a break. A break can give you time to do everyday activities or to relax, deal with stress and look after yourself.

Add to read later Read more about Planned and emergency respite

What is respite?

‘Respite’ or ‘respite care’ is when someone else takes care of the person you care for, so that you can have a break. A break can give you time to do everyday activities, deal with stress and look after yourself. When you are a carer, it’s important to regularly take time for yourself to rest and recharge.

Add to read later Read more about What is respite?

Financial support

There are income and financial supports that could be available to carers. This section provides links to services and information on financial support you may be eligible for.

Add to read later Read more about Financial support

If you can't provide care anymore

For whatever reason, at some time you might not be able to continue to look after the person you care for.

Add to read later Read more about If you can't provide care anymore
